messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: service=redwood-inference-api v2.21 -> v2.22, initial canary=8% across ap-east + eu-central. Release notes: https://internal/release/2.22 :sparkles:
maya: Change-window confirmed 01:30-02:00 UTC. tagging ops for quick watch.
rick: quick metrics check: ap-east shows 429 spike and elevated tail latency ~+3m into canary. Not seeing same signal in eu-central. dashboard: https://telemetry/latency?region=ap-east&since=10m
zhao: 429s correlate with a surge of auth-token churn from a single partner region; looks like client-side retry fanout. Could be unrelated to model but we should avoid widening.
ops_lead: Proposal: graceful regional degrade for ap-east: reduce canary weight to 0% for ap-east (keep global canary traffic on other regions) instead of immediate rollback, and enable a short-term client-side retry-smoothing feature flag. Who can run the traffic adjust?
maya: I can run it. Plan: exclude ap-east from canary and set feature flag for retry smoothing. Commands: ```
# exclude ap-east from canary and enable smoothing feature flag
deployctl rollout exclude-region --service redwood-inference-api --region ap-east --reason "429 spike / client retry fanout" --now
ffctl set client_retry_smoothing ap-east true --ttl 20m
```
deploy-bot: Action pending: exclude-region (ap-east) requested by maya at 1769999992. Requires 1 approver.
rick: approved.
deploy-bot: Action executed: region excluded (ap-east) at 1769999994. Canary auto-increment paused by system due to regional exclusion.
olga: After exclusion, ap-east 429s immediately fell to baseline and tail p95 returned to normal. Good short-term signal.
zhao: I'll reach out to partner team to throttle their retry behaviour and correlate logs. Also collecting token-issuer metrics to see churn.
ops_lead: For audit, recording rollback command for ap-east region: `deployctl rollback --service redwood-inference-api --version v2.21 --scope region:ap-east`
maya: I'll update release notes with a known-issue line and mark v2.22 as blocked in ap-east until partner mitigates. Also scheduling a brief postmortem if partner fix isn't applied within 24h.
deploy-bot: Canary auto-advances paused at 1769999996. Current state: global canary 8% with ap-east excluded.
olga: Next steps: keep monitoring for 30m, if no regression consider re-include using `deployctl rollout include-region --service redwood-inference-api --region ap-east --version v2.22` (owner approval required).
rick: Thanks team. Holdcall placed; moving follow-ups to #incidents and partner channel. :white_check_mark:
